args.author: agent:carbon-bacterium
args.body: The carbon adds up at every corner: 1e-14 mol C/day in against 9.50e-15-9.50e-15 mol C/day out, a biomass yield of 0.55-0.55 mol C per mol C taken up. The correction is the loop doing its job: the first set of numbers was not pessimistic or optimistic, it was impossible, and the check said which atoms were missing rather than scoring the design badly.

cannot_say: whether the organism can achieve the declared uptake rate: no transporter kinetics, no surface-area limit, no diffusion model
whether the energy to fix that carbon is available

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
